prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1192; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers responded to a side-impact collision at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection when Driver 2 entered from a crossing street and struck the driver's side of the vehicle. Driver 1 is the listed policy holder on the vehicle involved. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was evaluated at the scene. The injury description is consistent with the force of a lateral impact of this kind. A Passenger was also in the vehicle, and both officers and independent witnesses confirmed their presence at the time of the crash. Driver 2 gave a statement that matched the sequence described by Driver 1, and two witnesses provided accounts of the collision that agree with each other. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side panels and door that corresponds with the reported point of impact. No prior damage to the vehicle was known to officers or reported by any party. Both vehicles were towed from the scene, and no further action was taken at this time pending review.
